name: Image Studio
description: A prompt thread that generates images in a frame, with like, regenerate and download, and a panel with a masonry gallery and named styles.

props.name: variants
props.type: { id: string; src: string; alt: string; ratio?: number }[]
props.description: Results the frame generates, in turn: the first on load, the next on Generate again or a new prompt. ratio is width over height.

props.name: gallery
props.type: { id: string; src: string; alt: string; prompt?: string; ratio?: number }[]
props.description: Earlier images shown as a masonry in the Gallery tab. Choosing one shows it in the latest frame. Finished images are added to the top.

props.name: styles
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: string; src: string }[]
props.description: Named styles shown as tiles in the Styles tab. The chosen style appears as context on the composer.

props.name: prompt
props.description: The first prompt in the thread.

props.name: defaultStyle
props.description: Id of the style chosen at first.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in person shown at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It fills the viewport height. Also accepts every other div attribute.
